fullTextEN: Hello, hello everyone!
I am Bella.
I am from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 今天是我们 “约会系列” 的第三集！
fullTextEN: Today is the third episode of our 'Dating Series'!
That's right, today,

fullTextZH: 要来说一说我的约会故事。
fullTextEN: I want to talk about my dating story.
Do you have

fullTextZH: 一天约会过两个男生的经验呢？
fullTextEN: the experience of dating two guys in one day?
Hmm, I do!
A long, long time ago,

fullTextZH: 那个时候我去越南旅行，
fullTextEN: At that time, I went to Vietnam for a trip,

fullTextZH: 那个时候我是一个人旅行。
fullTextEN: At that time, I was traveling alone.

fullTextZH: 所以一个人旅行，我觉得很无聊，
fullTextEN: So traveling alone, I felt very bored,

fullTextZH: 我就下载了这个交友软体 Tinder，
fullTextEN: I downloaded this dating app Tinder,

fullTextZH: 看看可不可以认识新的人。
fullTextEN: to see if I could meet new people.
After downloading Tinder,

fullTextZH: 有两个男生问我：“你今天晚上有没有空？”
fullTextEN: two guys asked me: 'Are you free tonight?'

fullTextZH: 我不知道我应该见哪一个男生，
fullTextEN: I didn't know which guy I should meet,

fullTextZH: 所以啊，我就打电话给我的妹妹，
fullTextEN: so I called my sister,

fullTextZH: 问她：你觉得我应该怎么办？
fullTextEN: and asked her: What do you think I should do?
She told me:
"Meet them all!

fullTextZH: 你只剩下一个礼拜在越南，好好玩吧！”
fullTextEN: You only have one week left in Vietnam, have fun!"
So,

fullTextZH: 那天晚上我就真的约了这两个男生！
fullTextEN: That night I really did arrange to meet those two guys!
At dinner,
I met the first guy,

fullTextZH: 我们就叫他 Alex 吧。
fullTextEN: Let's call him Alex.

fullTextZH: 我跟 Alex 啊，一起吃晚餐。
fullTextEN: Alex and I had dinner together.
He is tall,
Looks okay,
But he doesn't talk much.
While we were eating,

fullTextZH: 我问了他很多很多问题，
fullTextEN: I asked him many questions,
But he only said "hmm" "oh",
So, I felt very bored.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我就决定先回去饭店见第二个男生 Mike。
fullTextEN: So, I decided to go back to the hotel to meet the second guy, Mike.

fullTextZH: 但是啊，让我紧张的事情来了！
fullTextEN: But then, something that made me nervous happened!

fullTextZH: 就在我准备离开的时候，
fullTextEN: Just as I was about to leave,
I asked Alex:
Hey, Alex,
Which hotel are you staying at?
Then he told me,
He is staying at this hotel.

fullTextZH: 没想到这个饭店是和我一样的饭店！
fullTextEN: I didn't expect it to be the same hotel as mine!
I live on the second floor,
He lives on the third floor.
So, Alex
He is very nice,

fullTextZH: 他说他要陪我一起走路回饭店。
fullTextEN: He said he wants to walk back to the hotel with me.

fullTextZH: 可是我那个时候心里只想着：
fullTextEN: But at that time, I was only thinking:

fullTextZH: “完蛋了！Mike 说他要来饭店见我，
fullTextEN: "Oh no! Mike said he wants to come to the hotel to see me,
What to do? What to do?"

fullTextZH: 所以呢，我很快就传讯息给 Mike，
fullTextEN: So, I quickly sent a message to Mike,

fullTextZH: 告诉他：“我们到其他的地方见面吧！”
fullTextEN: telling him: "Let's meet somewhere else!"
But unexpectedly, Mike said:
"I'm almost at your hotel!"
"And I'm riding a bike,

fullTextZH: 我需要把脚踏车停在你的饭店。”
fullTextEN: I need to park the bike at your hotel."
So I thought:
Alright, let's meet then!
I don't have any other methods either.

fullTextZH: 所以啊，我等了一下才下楼，
fullTextEN: So, I waited a bit before going downstairs,

fullTextZH: 因为我害怕我可能会看到 Alex。
fullTextEN: Because I was afraid I might see Alex.
So I opened the door,
Looked around,

fullTextZH: 还好，这时候饭店一个人都没有。
fullTextEN: Luckily, there was no one in the restaurant at that time.
After meeting Mike,

fullTextZH: 我觉得这个男生真的很不错！
fullTextEN: I felt this guy was really nice!
He was very tall,
and also very handsome,
and very interesting to talk to,

fullTextZH: 然后也很有礼貌、很温柔。
fullTextEN: and also very polite and gentle.
We had a great conversation,

fullTextZH: 然后我们聊得很晚很晚，
fullTextEN: and we talked very late into the night,

fullTextZH: 才慢慢的走回到我们的饭店，
fullTextEN: then slowly walked back to our hotel,

fullTextZH: 然后到停车场去拿 Mike 的脚踏车。
fullTextEN: and then went to the parking lot to get Mike's bike.

fullTextZH: Mike 呢，他在停车场跟我说，
fullTextEN: As for Mike, he told me in the parking lot,
he really enjoyed today's date,
he had a lot of fun,
So then,

fullTextZH: 他希望还可以有机会再见到我，
fullTextEN: He hopes he can have the chance to see me again,

fullTextZH: 然后给我一个小小的拥抱。
fullTextEN: and then give me a small hug.
But then, at that moment,
I turned around,

fullTextZH: 我发现 Alex 也在停车场！
fullTextEN: I found Alex was also in the parking lot!

fullTextZH: 没错，第一个男生 Alex 也在这里！
fullTextEN: That's right, the first guy Alex was also here!
But fortunately,
he didn't see me,
he was facing away from me.
At that time,
I really didn't know what to do,
because I was really too scared!
But then, I pretended nothing was wrong,
and continued chatting with Mike,

fullTextZH: 但是我心里想着是：“拜托，拜托！
fullTextEN: but in my heart I was thinking: "Please, please!

fullTextZH: 希望 Alex 不要发现我，
fullTextEN: I hope Alex doesn't notice me,
doesn't see me!"

fullTextZH: 然后呢，我一边和 Mike 聊天，
fullTextEN: Then, while chatting with Mike,
I was also sneaking a look,
Check if Alex has left.
And then later,

fullTextZH: 我和 Mike 聊了一下，
fullTextEN: I chatted with Mike for a bit,
When I was about to leave,
I took a look,
I discovered: "Hmm,
Alex is no longer here!"
But I thought to myself:
"Did Alex really not see me?
Or did he already see me,

fullTextZH: 可是他假装没有看到我呢？”
fullTextEN: but he pretended not to see me?"
But, no matter what,

fullTextZH: 那天真的是我人生中最紧张的约会！
fullTextEN: that day was really the most nerve-wracking date of my life!

fullTextZH: 好了，我的故事就说到这里。
fullTextEN: Alright, that's the end of my story.
If it were you,
what would you do?

fullTextZH: 你们会不会一天约会两个男生呢？
fullTextEN: Would you date two guys in one day?
Hmm, this experience taught me,

fullTextZH: 下次一天约会一个男生就好了！
fullTextEN: next time, just date one guy a day!

fullTextZH: 希望你们会喜欢今天的影片，
fullTextEN: I hope you enjoyed today's video,

fullTextZH: 那我们就下支影片见喽，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Then we'll see you in the next video, bye!
